camera.name: Elgato Facecam
camera.about_choice: name = (part of) the camera's name; it wins over index. Empty name: use index. run_tracker.bat --list-cameras shows the names.
camera.about: mirror=true: the avatar behaves like your reflection (your left brow moves the brow on your left of the screen).

smoothing.about: Exponential moving average. alpha is per frame at reference_fps: higher = snappier, lower = smoother.

tracking_loss.about: Face lost: hold the last pose for hold_s, then glide to neutral using return_alpha.
